cards.title: Make a plan
cards.description: Break the task into steps (no code)
cards.prompt:
Create a step-by-step plan for the current task. Do not write code.

From chat (ask only if missing): outcome in one sentence; what already exists; keep it a simple hobby project without extra complexity.

Rules: one step = one verifiable thing; per step — what to do · done criteria · how to verify; blockers and risks first; what to defer — separately. Working simple beats ideal architecture. Do not invent interfaces, libraries, or commands that are not in the repo. If good open source exists — use it instead of writing from scratch.
Little data — at most 3 questions.
Output: numbered list (one line per step).
Next: «Evaluate the work».

The project may be empty; it may have no rules. Do not invent what is not there.
Forbidden: inventing facts, names, numbers, and files; writing code (this card is analysis only); over-engineering “for later”; people-pleasing; if data is missing — ask, do not guess.

End with one line:
KEYCODE_STATUS: READY — plan is ready
or
KEYCODE_STATUS: NEED_DATA — more information needed

cards.title: Evaluate the work
cards.description: Justice: project quality score 0–10 and verdict
cards.prompt:
Evaluate the current plan or latest result honestly, without flattery.

Project quality score 0–10: 0–6 redo; 7–8 acceptable; 9–10 excellent. Below 7 — must redo.
Check: goal and done criteria are clear; logic gaps; hobby overcomplexity; what breaks first; top-3 fixes.
Do not inflate. For 9–10 you need 3 facts. If the goal is unclear — do not score 7 or above.

Reply: score N/10 · verdict · pros · cons · fixes.
Do not propose starting from scratch if targeted fixes are enough. Do not start code until asked.
Below 7 — «Code it» or «Fix bugs». 7 or above — «Code it».

The project may be empty — judge only what exists.
Forbidden: inventing facts and gaps; inflating the score out of pity; scoring 9–10 without three facts; if data is missing — ask, do not guess.

At the very end of the reply always add this line (N = your score 0-10):
KEYCODE_SCORE: N
If you cannot evaluate due to missing data, second line:
KEYCODE_STATUS: NEED_DATA

cards.title: Code it
cards.description: Magician: do the next plan step in code
cards.prompt:
Do the next open step of the approved plan — only that step, not everything at once.

Do not break what works. No data — 1–3 short questions; do not invent libraries or commands. Before risky changes (database, migrations, configs, auth) — backup. Do not add new features outside the step.

After: what changed · where to check · risks. Goal — correctness score 7 or above.
Done — «Test it». Blocker — «Make a plan».

The project may be empty; it may have no rules. Do not invent what is not there.
Forbidden: inventing libraries, commands, and output; doing extras outside the step; people-pleasing and hiding breakage; dangerous commands without an explicit “yes”; if data is missing — ask, do not guess.

End with one line:
KEYCODE_STATUS: DONE — step ready for verification
or
KEYCODE_STATUS: PARTIAL — step started but not finished
or
KEYCODE_STATUS: BLOCKED — need a human or data

cards.title: Test it
cards.description: Star: verify the result with facts, not words
cards.prompt:
Verify what was just done (the last step or a clearly named part).

Run relevant checks (commands, build, manual scenario). Show real output. Happy path + one edge case or failure (or why you cannot).
On failure — cause and the «Fix bugs» card; do not fix code yourself unless asked. On success — «TEST PASSED» and the checklist. Do not advance on red. If you cannot actually run checks — do not score above 4. If a human is needed — give a short scenario; do not mark «TEST PASSED».
Do not invent command output.
Result: green / red + project quality score 0–10 (below 7 = not ready).
7 or above — «Code it» (next step). Below 7 — «Fix bugs».

The project may be empty — judge only what exists.
Forbidden: inventing facts and gaps; inflating the score out of pity; scoring 9–10 without three facts; if data is missing — ask, do not guess.

At the very end of the reply always add this line (N = your score 0-10):
KEYCODE_SCORE: N
If you cannot evaluate due to missing data, second line:
KEYCODE_STATUS: NEED_DATA

cards.title: Fix bugs
cards.description: Tower: fix the breakage until acceptable score (7 or above)
cards.prompt:
Fix the defect from the last test, error, or project quality score below 7 out of 10.

Minimal fix only. No drive-by refactors or new features. Before critical changes — backup.
Loop: symptom → cause → what else may break → patch → verify the same way. While score is below 7 — repeat.
After 3 attempts with no progress — stop: what fails and why; 2 options with trade-offs; list where a human is needed.
Format: was → became → evidence.
7 or above — «Test it».

The project may be empty; it may have no rules. Do not invent what is not there.
Forbidden: inventing libraries, commands, and output; doing extras outside the step; people-pleasing and hiding breakage; dangerous commands without an explicit “yes”; if data is missing — ask, do not guess.

At the very end of the reply always add this line (N = your score 0-10):
KEYCODE_SCORE: N
If the step is not merely “scored”, second line one of:
KEYCODE_STATUS: NEED_DATA — not enough data
KEYCODE_STATUS: BLOCKED — need a human or cannot go further

cards.title: Polish it
cards.description: Strength: raise project quality score to 9–10
cards.prompt:
High polish mode. Goal — project quality score 9 or 10. Stopping at 7–8 is not allowed.

Loop: score N/10 → critical gaps → fixes only for those (do not expand scope) → recheck → new score. While 8 or below — repeat.
Maximum 2–3 iterations. If the score does not rise for two rounds in a row — stop and explain the ceiling. If the ceiling is below 9 due to external limits — name them after exhausting in-scope fixes.
Before starting — backup.
Report: final score · what raised quality · residual risk · what you left alone.
9 or above — «Save it».

The project may be empty; it may have no rules. Do not invent what is not there.
Forbidden: inventing libraries, commands, and output; doing extras outside the step; people-pleasing and hiding breakage; dangerous commands without an explicit “yes”; if data is missing — ask, do not guess.

At the very end of the reply always add this line (N = your score 0-10):
KEYCODE_SCORE: N
If the step is not merely “scored”, second line one of:
KEYCODE_STATUS: NEED_DATA — not enough data
KEYCODE_STATUS: BLOCKED — hit the ceiling, cannot go further

cards.title: Save it
cards.prompt:
Create a safe rollback point.

1. git status (or equivalent).
2. Meaningful commit or ready command — no force and no skipping checks unless asked.
3. No git — copy of key files with a date in the name.
4. Rollback in 1–2 commands.
5. Do not push changes or run dangerous commands (delete, reset, production) without an explicit “yes”.

End with: «Checkpoint saved» + where and how to roll back. Do not invent a successful commit.
Next: «Do it all» or «Code it» — by context.

The project may be empty; it may have no rules. Do not invent what is not there.
Forbidden: inventing libraries, commands, and output; doing extras outside the step; people-pleasing and hiding breakage; dangerous commands without an explicit “yes”; if data is missing — ask, do not guess.

End with one line:
KEYCODE_STATUS: SAVED — checkpoint saved
or
KEYCODE_STATUS: FAILED — could not save

cards.title: Do it all
cards.description: World: plan → work → verify, each step score 7 or above
cards.prompt:
Execute the plan from start to finish. Before starting — backup; on critical steps (database, migrations, auth) — also.

An item is closed only at score 7 or above (for 9–10 — «Polish it»). Per item: name → do → verify with facts → score → if below 7, fix → continue. No skipping, scope inflation, or masking red tests.
No plan — first 5–8 steps with acceptance criteria. More than 8 steps — only the first stage. Do not invent libraries or commands. Dangerous commands — backup and explicit “yes”.

If the score does not rise for 2–3 rounds on one task — simplify or change path. Need a human — list blockers, keep doing the rest. Three rounds with no movement — stop and give an honest status.
Finale: overall score · done / not done · risks · what to check manually. Do not declare success below 7.

The project may be empty; it may have no rules. Do not invent what is not there.
Forbidden: inventing libraries, commands, and output; doing extras outside the step; people-pleasing and hiding breakage; dangerous commands without an explicit “yes”; if data is missing — ask, do not guess.

At the very end always:
KEYCODE_SCORE: N

If the approved scope is closed and checks are green:
KEYCODE_GATE: PASS
KEYCODE_NEXT: release-v1/release-plan

If not ready or checks are red:
KEYCODE_GATE: FAIL
If you stopped due to blockers:
KEYCODE_STATUS: BLOCKED

cards.title: Result overview
cards.description: High Priestess: briefly — task, done, not done, next
cards.prompt:
Read this chat and the repo context. Do not write or change code. Do not invent evidence.

Four short blocks (1–3 items each):
1. Task
2. Done
3. Not done — steps, failures, blockers
4. Next step — one card: Make a plan / Evaluate the work / Code it / Test it / Fix bugs / Polish it / Save it / Do it all

If there is no plan — recommend «Make a plan». If work stalled — fifth block: reason and options (simplify / return to plan / ask a human).
Do not add KEYCODE_SCORE, KEYCODE_GATE, KEYCODE_NEXT, or KEYCODE_STATUS lines.

The project may be empty — write only what is visible in the chat.
Forbidden: inventing what was done; writing or changing code; adding KEYCODE_SCORE, KEYCODE_GATE, KEYCODE_NEXT, or KEYCODE_STATUS lines.
